_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no crm-families/lead contract exists (see lib/api-client/crm-leads.ts)
what_this_is: The office's own lead file for the CRM area (Relationships → Sales pipeline), as the staff lead record shows it today: the person and the enquiry, the recorded pipeline movement, the recorded contact history, the recorded next step and who is handling the lead.

APP-AUTHORED example records with provenance. crm-families (leads, pipeline, customer sync, lead assignment) is unbuilt — docs/02-architecture/microservices.md — so no service response is being recorded here, the same pattern as lib/fixtures/family/workspace.json and lib/fixtures/property/lot-lifecycle.json. When a lead/customer-records contract freezes, this file is replaced by recorded contract fixtures and lib/api-client/crm-leads.ts gains the live branch.
cross_references: Person fields (name, phone, email, source, topic, message) for a record with an `inquiry_reference` are that recorded row of lib/fixtures/crm/inquiries.json — pinned by tests/fixture-contract/crm-leads.test.ts.

For a person who is also an agent-portal prospect, `owner`, `stage`, `first_contact_at`, `last_contact_at`, `stage_history`, `next_action` and `activity` mirror lib/fixtures/agent/workspace.json exactly, so the office's record and the agent's record can never tell different stories about the same lead. The fixture-contract test fails on any drift.
`activity[].id` values are the agent workspace's own contact-entry ids where the entry exists there.
No amount, fee or commission figure appears anywhere: the lead's value is not this file's business (the recorded pricing/finance fixtures own money), and nothing here is quoted to a family.

The office's front-desk assignment (the inquiry's `assigned_to`) is deliberately NOT copied as the lead owner: lead assignment waits on the customer-records service, and `owner` is the recorded agent working the lead.
dates: Every `at` / `first_contact_at` / `last_contact_at` is a true instant (ISO-8601 UTC). The record renders them in Asia/Manila through lib/agent/agent-view.ts manilaDay() / manilaTime() — the same helpers the agent record uses.
The first stage move is `new` at `first_contact_at`; the last move is the current `stage` at `last_contact_at`; moves are in chronological order.
stages: The PRD pipeline stages (commerce-catalog §33), the same vocabulary the agent record renders: new → contacted → qualified → presentation → proposal → reserved → sold.
